Name: Selective Trickplay Generator
Description: Generates trickplay only if any selected user has not watched the movie or episode, and trickplay does not already exist.
Overview: Automatically generates trickplay (preview) thumbnails for movies and episodes that are unwatched by at least one selected user.
Changelog: Initial release - Core functionality for selective trickplay generation, multi-user watch status checking, scheduled task with configurable users, comprehensive logging, and plugin configuration UI support.
